passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.text: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

spells.name: Obliterate
spells.text: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

spells.name: Indestructible
spells.text: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

spells.name: Death's Grasp
spells.text: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

spells.name: Realm of Death
spells.text: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

archetype.value: Mordekaiser plays as a bruiser who deals damage up close, shields himself, and pulls enemies toward him.

axis.value: Mordekaiser favors long trades because landing three attacks or spells activates his damage aura and Move Speed.

winCondition.value: Mordekaiser can isolate a victim with Realm of Death and keep stolen stats until that victim respawns if he kills them.

spikes.at: After three attacks or spells against champions or monsters
spikes.why: Mordekaiser gains a damage aura and Move Speed.
